Interview with Nate Rogers
On the latest podcast
episode

Jason Lee
. In this conversation, Rogers chatted about the dynamic of a celebrity pushing back on questions, and how his experience reflects the limitations of entertainment journalism. Additionally, Rogers discussed his reporting on blinding headlights.
